Subject: Discovery recap — staggered eval kickoff & technical deep dive

Hi Sara — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a few suggested next steps to get to a short evaluation: 

What we heard / success criteria
- Primary objective: validate Redwood inference latency and integration for BrightPath’s triage assistant (<= 300ms median token latency at test volume).
- Quality bar: > 85% accuracy on the 120-case prompt set you described (we'll run side-by-side evals).
- Security/controls: SOC 2 + VPC/network segmentation questions flagged by your team.

Proposed two-step approach (staggered kickoff)
1) Short demo (30–45m): walk through Redwood API, routing/fallbacks, and live inference examples tailored to BrightPath prompts — goal: align on integration model and telemetry.
2) Evaluation kickoff (60m): finalize trial plan, agree on success metrics, hand off the prompt pack/eval harness, and schedule the 2-week trial window.

Availability options (please pick any that work or propose alternatives)
- Tue 8 Jun: 10:00–11:00 ET or 16:00–17:00 CET
- Thu 10 Jun: 14:00–15:00 ET
- Mon 13 Jun: 11:00–12:00 ET

Pre-reads / attachments: I’ve attached a short flow doc (proposed-eval-flow.pdf) and a sample prompt pack. If you can confirm the preferred slot and the right security contact for the SOC 2 questionnaire, we’ll lock the calendar and share the kickoff agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to the evaluation phase.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the clear path. We’re excited to move forward. A few quick notes: 

- We like the staggered approach (demo first, then evaluation kickoff).
- Preferred slot: Tue 8 Jun 10:00 ET works best for our PM + Eng + Infosec triage (Sara, David Kim (Eng), and Infosec will try to join).
- For the SOC 2 questionnaire / evidence: looping in Infosec (infosec@brightpathhealth.com) — they prefer to receive the questionnaire and any network architecture diagrams before the evaluation kickoff.
- Prompt access: could you share a sanitized sample prompt set ahead of the kickoff so our clinical SME can review?

If you can confirm the 8 Jun slot and include a calendar invite, I’ll get the internal attendees locked. Also share any pre-kickoff checklist you need from our side (API keys, whitelisted IPs, data handling notes).
